verdict.summary: PR #300 at 9d24af45e2c9d8b9a700b153aa46ab8f5f890524 is blocked by a capability-source contract regression and missing trusted acceptance evidence for the exact head.

blockingFindings.title: The capability-floor contract is incorrectly moved from plugins to packages
blockingFindings.details: The issue relocates six managed repository gitlinks, but the diff also declares all of packages—including implementation components such as core and manager—to be the authored capability-plugin source. No corresponding installer or capability-source migration is included, and verify-single-product also stops requiring the plugins root. Preserve plugins as the authored capability root while documenting managed product repositories under packages, or implement and validate an explicitly authorized full capability-source migration.

blockingFindings.title: Required validation and acceptance evidence is missing for the reviewed head
blockingFindings.details: For marius-patrik/Andromeda PR #300 at head 9d24af45e2c9d8b9a700b153aa46ab8f5f890524, the trusted evidence verifies only that the PR is open. It supplies no verified results for git diff --check, git submodule status --recursive, bun run ci, or fresh-clone submodule initialization. Claims in the untrusted PR body cannot satisfy these gates, so exact-head validation remains unproven.
